messages.subject: Multi-group LPA
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

First of all, thank you very much for this great package.

I am running LPA on data from 3 different countries, and I would like to compare the fit of the solution among the 3 groups. Is there any way to accomplish it in tidyLPA, or any recommendations as to how I could do it?

Thank you very much for your attention.

Emanuele
